title: Fema / RBI | RBI Revises Concentration Risk Framework for IDF-NBFCs in Upper Layer
description: Fema / RBIRBI amends NBFC concentration risk directions to apply NBFC-IFC large exposure limits to IDF-NBFCs subject to Upper Layer regulations.The post RBI Revises Concentration Risk Framework for IDF-NBFCs in Upper Layer appeared first on TaxGuru.
